response.query: What pilot progression thresholds (feasibility, engagement, preliminary effect sizes) will we adopt and what literature benchmarks justify these criteria?
response.answer: Pilot progression thresholds include feasibility, engagement, and preliminary effect sizes; benchmarks are typically set at 70% feasibility, 80% engagement, and 0.3 effect size.
